name: Things 3
description: Things 3 is a personal task manager for Apple devices that organizes inbox items, projects, areas, tags, schedules, deadlines, reminders, and daily plans.
agentUseSummary: Things 3 cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because Cultured Code offers no public cloud API or direct Codex/OpenClaw connection, while its supported URL scheme, Shortcuts, AppleScript, and Mail to Things surfaces require an explicit device-local authority that Relay Marketplace does not currently ship.

blocked.label: Connect Things 3
blocked.description: Relay does not show a cloud Connect flow because Things has no public account API and Relay does not silently substitute a Mac or iPhone local authority.

blocked.label: Use device-local automation
blocked.description: Things URLs, Apple Shortcuts, AppleScript, and Mail to Things require an installed app or user-configured local workflow; the current Marketplace runtime does not mount or execute that device-local authority.

blocked.label: Access private Things data
blocked.description: Relay never reads or writes the Things database directly, asks for Things Cloud credentials, reverse engineers the sync service, reuses local app state, or installs an unreviewed third-party MCP server.

blocked.label: Change Things content
blocked.description: Creating, editing, completing, canceling, moving, duplicating, or deleting to-dos, projects, headings, areas, tags, schedules, deadlines, and notes remains unavailable until Relay ships explicit local execution and approval boundaries.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Relay ships a separately disclosed, user-authorized device-local Things connector using only Cultured Code's supported automation methods.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay does not mount a third-party Things MCP server or silently bridge OpenClaw to device-local Things automation.
Relay does not mount a third-party Things MCP server or silently bridge Hermes to device-local Things automation.

providerSetup.blocker: Cultured Code provides no public Things account API and says Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw have no direct connection. Supported automation is local to an Apple device or email workflow, while Relay's current Marketplace runtime intentionally excludes local-app command execution and cannot truthfully offer that authority from Railway.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Things Cloud credentials, inspect the local database, install an unofficial MCP server, or show Connect. Reconsider after Relay ships a separately disclosed Mac/iPhone local-connection architecture with explicit app presence, user authorization, per-action approval, result redaction, audit, and no cloud fallback.

evidence.supports: Cultured Code says it offers no direct connection for Codex, Claude Code, or OpenClaw; identifies Things URLs, Shortcuts, AppleScript, and Mail to Things as safe methods; and warns that database access and sharing Things Cloud credentials are unsafe.
Cultured Code states that Things has no public API and points only to local-device URLs, Shortcuts, AppleScript, and Mail to Things.

Cultured Code documents the version-2 things URL scheme, app launch and enablement requirements, x-callback behavior, local IDs, mutation authorization tokens, and commands that can expose or change private task content.
Cultured Code documents Things actions inside Apple's Shortcuts app, their Apple-platform requirements, content-bearing item types, mutation operations, and platform-specific limitations.
